verdict.rationale: Aircall documents a broad Public API covering outbound dialing, recording pause/resume, AI transcription, sentiment and summaries, campaign lifecycle, SMS messages, and webhooks. Nothing establishes parity with the UI, and several UI features (IVR and business-hours configuration, queue callback, shared inbox, AI Agents/Assistants setup) have no evidenced API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, API coverage for IVR/routing configuration, inbox, and AI agent management, and independent corroboration of API completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
